WORKING NOTES

Try this: Try a warmer palette.
IMAGE PROMPT
A minimalist, high-key beauty portrait of an original
young woman against a near-white seamless
backdrop, framed vertically and cropped from the
upper chest up. Long, straight, glossy black hair
falls past her shoulders, with a few loose strands
drifting across her face. Her skin is smooth and
matte, her lips a muted rosy-brown, and her
expression calm, direct, and slightly contemplative.
Her arms are folded across her chest, one hand
resting on the opposite shoulder, with a thin silver
band on one finger. Soft, even studio lighting with
little visible shadow, a cool, restrained palette of
off-white, pale blue-gray, and deep black, generous
negative space that keeps focus on her face and
hands. Clean, airy, serene, and quietly
melancholic, in the style of a contemporary
skincare or jewelry campaign.
